answer.answer: Ujjwala 2.0 distinguishes itself with a special facility for migrant households, providing an additional allocation of 1.6 Crore LPG connections [E02]. Its predecessor programme, the original Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana launched in May 2016, established a clean-cooking transition by promoting LPG as clean cooking fuel among rural and deprived families who traditionally relied on firewood, coal, or cow-dung cakes, helping reduce health risks for women and minimize environmental pollution [E02].

claim_to_evidence.claim: Ujjwala 2.0 has a special facility for migrant households with additional allocation of 1.6 Crore LPG connections
The predecessor programme promoted clean cooking fuel like LPG among rural and deprived families who traditionally relied on firewood, coal, or cow-dung cakes
This shift helps reduce health risks for women and minimizes environmental pollution
